cards.ex: Our company's fiscal year ends in June, so we're rushing to meet all our targets.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamizning moliya yili iyunda tugaydi, shuning uchun biz barcha maqsadlarimizga erishishga shoshilmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki kompaniyaning bir yillik byudjet davri.

cards.ex: The demand for consumer goods has increased significantly in recent months.
cards.exUz: So'nggi oylarda iste'mol mollariga talab sezilarli darajada oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar foydalanishi uchun ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulotlar.

cards.ex: People have more disposable income now, so they're spending more on entertainment.
cards.exUz: Odamlarning hozirda foydalanishdagi daromadi ko'proq, shuning uchun ular ko'ngil ochishga ko'proq pul sarflashyapti.

cards.ex: Analysts are predicting a bear market due to rising interest rates.
cards.exUz: Tahlilchilar foiz stavkalari oshishi sababli bozor pasayishini bashorat qilishmoqda.

cards.ex: The economy is strong, and we're in the middle of a bull market.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot kuchli va biz bozor ko'tarilishining o'rtasidamiz.

cards.ex: Solar energy is becoming increasingly cost-effective as technology improves.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya yaxshilanishi bilan quyosh energiyasi tobora tejamkor bo'lib bormoqda.

cards.ex: Understanding consumer behaviour is crucial for successful marketing.
cards.exUz: Xaridor xulqini tushunish muvaffaqiyatli marketing uchun juda muhimdir.

cards.ex: Rising inflation is impacting living standards for many families.
cards.exUz: Infliatsiya o'sishi ko'plab oilalarning turmush darajasiga ta'sir qilmoqda.

cards.ex: Large corporations benefit from economies of scale, reducing their production costs.
cards.exUz: Yirik korporatsiyalar miqyos iqtisodiyotidan foydalanadi, bu ularning ishlab chiqarish xarajatlarini kamaytiradi.

cards.ex: He ran up a huge debt after gambling losses.
cards.exUz: U qimor o'yinlaridagi yo'qotishlardan so'ng katta qarzga botdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p qarz yig'moq, qarzi ko'payib ketmoq.

cards.ex: It's important to know your consumer rights when buying online.
cards.exUz: Onlayn xarid qilishda iste'molchi huquqlaringizni bilish muhim.

cards.ex: I got a really good deal on this car - it was a bargain!
cards.exUz: Men bu mashinani juda yaxshi narxga oldim - bu haqiqiy topilma edi!
cards.uzDef: Arzon narxga sotib olmoq, foydali kelishuv tuzmoq.

cards.ex: During periods of tight credit, it's harder for businesses to expand.
cards.exUz: Kredit olish qiyin bo'lgan davrlarda biznesning kengayishi qiyinlashadi.

cards.ex: Many developing countries struggle with a heavy debt burden.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina rivojlanayotgan davlatlar og'ir qarz yuklamasi bilan kurashmoqda.

cards.ex: The bank raised its interest rate, making mortgages more expensive.
cards.exUz: Bank foiz stavkasini oshirdi, bu esa ipoteka xarajatlarini oshirdi.

cards.ex: Consumers are angry about the recent price hike in petrol.
cards.exUz: Iste'molchilar yaqinda benzin narxining oshishidan g'azabda.

cards.ex: She went on a shopping spree after getting her bonus.
cards.exUz: U bonus olganidan keyin xarid qilishga berildi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p narsa sotib olish, xarid qilishga berilish.

cards.ex: Companies try to build brand loyalty through marketing and good customer service.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar marketing va yaxshi mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish orqali brendga sadoqatni shakllantirishga harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: Expanding the consumer base is essential for business growth.
cards.exUz: Biznesning o'sishi uchun xaridorlar bazasini kengaytirish muhim.

cards.ex: Ethical consumerism is growing as people become more aware of social issues.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ijtimoiy muammolardan xabardor bo'lgani sayin, axloqiy iste'mol o'sib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va ekologik mahsulotlar sotib olish.

cards.ex: I had to get a refund because the product was faulty.
cards.exUz: Mahsulot noto'g'ri bo'lgani uchun pulni qaytarib olishga majbur bo'ldim.

cards.ex: The charity is cash-strapped and struggling to continue its work.
cards.exUz: Xayriya tashkiloti pulga muhtoj va o'z ishini davom ettirishga qiynalmoqda.

cards.ex: We live in a consumer-driven society where marketing plays a huge role.
cards.exUz: Biz xaridorlar talabi bilan boshqariladigan jamiyatda yashaymiz, bu erda marketing katta rol o'ynaydi.

cards.ex: The market for smartphones is approaching saturation.
cards.exUz: Smartfonlar bozori to'yinganlikka yaqinlashmoqda.

cards.ex: In an affluent society, people often prioritize luxury goods over necessities.
cards.exUz: Badavlat jamiyatda odamlar ko'pincha zarur narsalardan ko'ra hashamatli mahsulotlarga ustunlik berishadi.

cards.ex: The economic downturn has led to widespread job losses.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy pasayish keng ko'lamli ishsizlikka olib keldi.

cards.ex: It takes discipline to get out of debt and manage your finances wisely.
cards.exUz: Qarzdan qutulish va moliyangizni oqilona boshqarish uchun intizom kerak.

cards.ex: Buying a cheap car that constantly needs repairs is often penny-wise, pound-foolish.
cards.exUz: Doimiy ta'mirlashga muhtoj arzon mashina sotib olish ko'pincha arzonga uchib qimmatga tushish demakdir.
cards.uzDef: Kichik narsalarni tejab, katta xarajat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Analyzing the value chain helps companies identify areas for cost reduction.
cards.exUz: Qiymat zanjirini tahlil qilish kompaniyalarga xarajatlarni kamaytirish sohalarini aniqlashga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: We went to the mall and shopped 'til we dropped.
cards.exUz: Biz savdo markaziga bordik va tolguncha xarid qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p xarid qilmoq, charchaguncha do'konda aylanmoq.
